subject: AI Engineer Salaries: What's Actually Possible
body:
View this post on the web at 

AI engineers are making more than $200,000 a year. At companies like Meta, some are making as much as $1.5 million. But here’s the part that most people miss.
As a former engineering manager at Meta who has hired hundreds of engineers, I want to show you what’s actually behind those headline numbers. If you plan your career based on a headline, you’re likely to be disappointed. In this newsletter, I’ll walk you through the hiring manager’s playbook on AI engineer pay, based on real, recent data.

subject: Data Analyst at Precision AQ — Remote - Just Went Live
body:
Hi Avinash,

A role matching your profile just went live on Abekus.ai — Data Analyst at Precision AQ, part of Precision Medicine Group. Fully remote in India.

Remote · India · 1+ years · salary negotiable

SQL, data analysis, data quality checks, stakeholder coordination

Pharma and US healthcare analytics

You'd run the analytics that client deliverables depend on — writing the SQL, applying the quality checks and validations before anything ships, and working with the senior analyst and delivery lead to make the process better rather than just repeating it. The real payoff is the domain: managed markets and US healthcare analytics is a specialisation that stays valuable, and it's hard to pick up outside a firm that does it for a living.

If that's your kind of work, apply here. Earlier applicants typically have a better shot.

Best,
Team Abekus
